title: Following Jesus: Characteristics of authentic discipleship
description:
Jesus called His disciples to “come and follow”Him. But what does this mean and how can  you obey today?

In this book, the author points out key  characteristics of discipleship as seen in the early followers of Jesus. By looking at their lives and seeking to imitate them, you too can live the life God intended for you to live and impact the world for His glory.
